text:
Maya: Weekly health check — model mix + rollout signal for ACME (prod). Quick thread with numbers and asks.

Maya: TL;DR: noticeable shift to quantized variant, fallback rate up, p95 latency drift, spend spike. Flagging as a potential renewal risk if not stabilized.

Ravi: Can you paste the raw mix + perf numbers so I can sanity-check autoscale?

Maya: ```
Model mix (last 7d):
- redwood-llama-2-13b: 52%
- redwood-mistral-7b: 24%
- redwood-llama-2-13b-q4 (quant): 14%
- other/fallbacks: 10%

Fallback rate: 7.4% (was 3.1% prev week)
Latency p95: 620ms (was 480ms)
Error rate (5xx): 0.8% (was 0.3%)
Spend delta (w/w): +28%
Notes: fallback spikes correlate with long-context requests >1024 tokens and a canary of q4 quant models on 3/15.
```

Ravi: 7.4% is rough. Is that measured at the routing layer or recorded after runtime errors?

Jordan: Routing logs show increased "model_unavailable" hits that triggered fallback to hosted high-tier (hence spend). The router routed ~12% of requests to q4 variant; ~60% of those hit capacity constraints and fell back.

deploy-bot: Canary deployed redwood-llama-2-13b-q4 -> completed at 2026-03-15T09:12Z (canary id: c-4287).

Ellie: We started the onboarding nudges Monday which included the new SDK default `prefer_fast=true` in the code sample. I asked the customer if they changed config — they confirmed enabling a beta toggle on 3/15.

Ravi: That matches. prefer_fast routes to quant variants when available. More users hitting quant means more overflow to fallback when quant instances throttle.

Maya: Action items: 
1) Ravi: check Dedicated pool autoscale thresholds + temp capacity bump; monitor p95 and fallback rate over next 24h.
2) Jordan: run quick quality eval comparing q4 outputs vs non-quant on our canonical prompt set; call out any hallucination/score regressions. ETA 24h.
3) Ellie: reach out to ACME PM, ask to revert `prefer_fast` or increase `max_seq` to avoid long-token routing to q4. Offer a short playbook and one-hour triage call.
4) Maya: I will mark renewal-risk as "monitoring" and include this thread in next weekly with updated metrics.

Ellie: Ack — scheduling call tomorrow 10am PT, will send calendar and a short one-page playbook.

Ravi: I'm going to add +2 GPU equiv to the dedicated pool for the customer for 48h and watch cost impact; will rollback if no change.

Jordan: Starting eval now, will post sample diffs to this thread and attach short perf table.

Maya: Thanks all. If fallback rate doesn't drop by 50% after config revert + temporary capacity, escalate to Eng Runtime for kernel/kv cache tuning.

Ellie: FYI I've CC'd their AE in the call invite. If we can get a small win on latency/spend, it reduces renewal churn.

Maya: Good. Quick note: annotate the customer health dashboard with the model-mix anomaly tag so PM/AE see it. @Ravi can you set the alert threshold at 5% fallback?

Ravi: Will set alert at 5% (email + #cs-alerts).

Maya: Cool. I'll check back in this thread tomorrow with numbers. :eyes:
